blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY —Domestic bank deposits in Cagayan de Oro, the seat of Northern Mindanao, climbed to P180 billion as of December 31 last year, underscoring the city’s status as a rapidly expanding economic hub. According to data from the Philippine Deposit Insurance Corporation (PDIC), the city ranked 15th among the top cities in the country in terms of domestic bank deposits, trailing Davao City, which secured the 10th spot with P340 billion Banker Amado Castaño Jr., former president and chief executive officer of the Cebu-based Fairbanks Rural Bank, noted that Cagayan de Oro also leads all other cities in Northern Mindanao […]...
